Interface CausalTopics

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface CausalTopics
Resolves a topic name to its stable Kafka UUID — the identity CausalDependencies key their coordinates by, so that a topic deleted and recreated under the same name is treated as a different topic. A ConsumerRecord carries only the topic name; building a UUID-keyed dependency from it (via
invalid reference 
CausalDependencies#from
or CausalDependencies.builder(CausalTopics)) needs this mapping.

Usage

Back the resolver with a Kafka Admin the caller already owns; Parsley resolves UUIDs through it and caches them, and never closes it — the caller keeps ownership: 
try (Admin admin = Admin.create(adminConfig)) {
    CausalTopics topics = CausalTopics.of(admin);
    CausalDependencies deps = CausalDependencies.using(topics).observe(consumedRecord);
    producer.send(deps.stamp(new ProducerRecord<>("orders", key, value)));
}
Tests without a live broker can supply a fixed name→UUID map with of(Map).

Thread safety

An Admin-backed resolver is safe to share across threads; resolved UUIDs are cached so a topic is described at most once.
